title: Gate G: the long-horizon campaign's counters see what they count
note: D-2026-181. Each blinds a counter the campaign reports apart: a second execution, a second receipt, a restart, or a retry miscounted as a duplicate. tests/test_research_horizon.py holds the counters to each other over a short stage with a crash in it, and the duplicate counter to a positive control. D-2026-188 adds three that blind the stage boundary's withdrawals: the bytes never withdrawn, the kept results unreported, the ledger not followed; a short stage ending in both withdrawals holds them.

mutations.name: RH1_a_second_execution_is_not_counted
mutations.rationale: G: a task executed twice over the horizon reads as executed once

mutations.name: RH2_a_second_receipt_is_not_counted
mutations.rationale: G: a proposal received twice reads as received once

mutations.name: RH3_a_retry_is_a_duplicate
mutations.rationale: G: the attempts a retry is allowed are counted as duplicate answers

mutations.name: RH4_a_restart_is_not_counted
mutations.rationale: G: a resumption after a crash is not counted, so restarts and resets merge

mutations.name: RH5_the_bytes_are_never_withdrawn
mutations.rationale: G: the only withdrawal measured is one that moves nothing here, as at the 1,000 stage before D-2026-188

mutations.name: RH6_kept_results_are_not_reported
mutations.rationale: G: a withdrawal that moved nothing is reported without the reason it moved nothing

mutations.name: RH7_the_ledger_is_not_followed
mutations.rationale: G: the research records resting on a withdrawn result keep their standing
